title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
claim: Residual connections enable deeper convolutional networks and improve image recognition accuracy.

title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
claim: Dropout reduces overfitting by preventing co-adaptation of hidden units. Future work should evaluate robustness under distribution shift.

title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
claim: Batch normalization stabilizes and accelerates deep network training. Future work should evaluate robustness under distribution shift.
